title: Harness Engineering for Software Engineering via Modular Executable Dev-Primitives
title_zh: 通过模块化可执行开发原语实现软件工程中的“Harness 工程”

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with terminal access have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating software engineering tasks. However, existing agents remain brittle on long-horizon workflows, where they must repeatedly reconstruct program state scattered across source files, configurations, tests, dependencies, and runtime behavior, leading to increasingly long interaction histories, context explosion, and semantic drift. Large repositories further complicate the identification of task-relevant components. To address these challenges, we introduce Dev-Primitives ( Development Primitives ), a modular and executable abstraction that transforms repository components from passive software artifacts into active participants in software engineering. Each Dev-Primitive pairs a repository artifact with a resident LLM, which gives the artifact an agent-native interface grounded in its own implementation and dependencies, enabling natural-language reasoning, inter-component communication, and localized self-modification. Building on Dev-Primitives, we propose HERMES , a H arness E ngineering framework for software enginee R ing via M odular E xecutable Dev-Primitive S , which instantiates these primitives at repository scale through a dependency-aware dynamic activation mechanism and a bug diagnosis mechanism that maps execution evidence back to the components that must be revised. Extensive experiments on four software engineering benchmarks demonstrate that HERMES outperforms matched baseline harnesses by 12.4% on average. Moreover, when paired with strong activation and diagnosis models, HERMES, even with Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives, remains within 4.5% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6 Sol configuration across all four benchmarks, while reducing inference cost by 26.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, highlighting the importance of harness design in software engineering agents.
paragraphs.zh: 配备终端访问权限的大型语言模型（LLM）已在自动化软件工程任务方面展现出强大能力。 然而，现有智能体在处理长期工作流程时仍存在脆弱性：它们必须反复重构分散在源代码文件、配置、测试、依赖项和运行时行为中的程序状态，从而导致交互历史不断延长、上下文爆炸以及语义漂移。 大型代码库进一步增加了识别任务相关组件的难度。 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 Dev-Primitives（开发原语），一种模块化且可执行的抽象层，它将代码库中的组件从被动的软件产物转变为软件工程的主动参与者。 每个 Dev-Primitive 都将一个代码库产物与一个常驻 LLM 配对，使该产物获得基于自身实现和依赖项的智能体原生接口，从而实现自然语言推理、组件间通信以及局部自修改。 基于 Dev-Primitives，我们提出了 HERMES——一个通过模块化可执行开发原语进行软件工程的“H arness E ngineering”框架。该框架通过依赖感知的动态激活机制和能将执行证据追溯至需修改组件的故障诊断机制，在代码库规模上实例化这些原语。 在四个软件工程基准上的广泛实验表明，HERMES 的平均性能比匹配的基线框架高出 12.4%。 此外，当与强大的激活和诊断模型结合时，即使使用 Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives，HERMES 在所有四个基准上的表现也与同构的 GPT-5.6 Sol 配置差距不超过 4.5%，同时在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上将推理成本降低了 26.2%，凸显了框架设计在软件工程智能体中的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with terminal access have demonstrated remarkable capability in automating real-world software engineering ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Existing approaches broadly follow two paradigms. Pipeline-based methods prescribe the control flow in advance, decomposing software repair into stages such as fault localization, patch generation, and validation ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Agent-based methods instead place an LLM in an interactive execution environment, where it can inspect repositories, execute commands, modify code, and react to runtime feedback through a general action loop ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . Recent benchmarks have meanwhile expanded from isolated issue resolution to tasks that require sustained interaction with repositories, terminals, tests, and runtime systems ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 配备终端访问权限的大型语言模型（LLM）已在自动化真实世界软件工程方面展现出卓越能力（Yang 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2025）。 现有方法大致遵循两种范式。 基于流程的方法预先规定了控制流，将软件修复分解为故障定位、补丁生成和验证等阶段（Xia 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2024）。 而基于智能体的方法则将 LLM 置于交互式执行环境中，使其能够通过通用动作循环检查代码库、执行命令、修改代码并对运行时反馈作出响应（Wang 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2025）。 与此同时，近期的基准测试已从孤立的问题解决扩展到需要与代码库、终端、测试和运行时系统持续交互的任务（Merrill 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Both paradigms remain brittle once such interactions extend over long horizons. Append-only histories and passive compression lead to context explosion, semantic drift, and degraded reasoning ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . In software repositories, however, the difficulty is not only the length of the history: the relevant program state is scattered across interdependent source files, configurations, and tests, so a change to one file often requires matching changes in the code that calls it, its configuration, and its tests. Each edit also changes the repository itself, so the agent must repeatedly re-inspect affected files and work out what each change requires elsewhere, a burden that no amount of history compression removes. Recent evaluations expose this clearly: on whole-repository migration, only 5.4% of 520 agent runs complete all evaluation stages ( Hong et al., 2026 ) , and similar difficulties appear in long-horizon software evolution and repository generation ( Le et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ) . This raises a natural question: instead of requiring an agent to repeatedly reconstruct distributed program state, can individual software components reason about their own responsibilities and communicate relevant information directly to one another?
paragraphs.zh: 一旦此类交互跨越长时间跨度，这两种范式都会变得脆弱不堪。 仅追加式历史记录和被动压缩会导致上下文爆炸、语义漂移以及推理能力下降（Liu et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a）。 然而，在软件仓库中，困难不仅在于历史记录的长度：相关的程序状态分散在相互依赖的源文件、配置和测试中，因此对其中一个文件的修改通常需要在调用它的代码、其配置以及其测试中进行相应的改动。 每次编辑也会改变仓库本身，因此智能体必须反复重新检查受影响的文件，并确定各处修改所需的具体内容——这种负担是任何程度的历史记录压缩都无法消除的。 近期的评估清楚地揭示了这一点：在整仓库迁移任务中，520次智能体运行仅有5.4%完成了所有评估阶段（Hong et al., 2026）；类似的问题也出现在长时间跨度的软件演进和仓库生成任务中（Le et al., 2025；Ding et al., 2025）。 这引出了一个自然的问题：与其要求智能体反复重构分散的程序状态，是否可以让各个软件组件自行推理其职责，并直接向彼此传递相关信息？

paragraphs.en: We answer this question with Dev-Primitives ( Development Primitives ), modular and executable abstractions that transform repository components from passive code artifacts into active participants. Each Dev-Primitive wraps a repository artifact with a resident LLM , and this is what makes the artifact agent-native: because the resident model reads the implementation it is attached to, the component can be addressed in natural language and can answer for its own implementation and dependencies. Through this interface it interprets requests, reasons over its own artifact, communicates requirements and constraints to other primitives, and modifies its implementation when necessary, so that component-specific information and reasoning stay with the artifact that owns them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Dev-Primitives（开发原语）来回答这个问题。Dev-Primitives 是模块化且可执行的抽象层，能够将仓库组件从被动的代码产物转变为主动参与者。 每个 Dev-Primitive 都会为一个仓库产物封装一个常驻的 LLM，这正是使该产物具备智能体原生性的原因：由于常驻模型会读取其所附带的实现，因此该组件可以用自然语言进行交互，并能就自身的实现和依赖关系作出回应。 通过这一接口，它能够解释请求、对自身产物进行推理、与其他原语沟通需求和约束条件，并在必要时修改其实现，从而确保与组件相关的信息和推理始终保留在所属的产物中。

paragraphs.en: Dev-Primitives alone, however, do not determine which components a task should involve: repositories may contain thousands of components, and activating all of them would be wasteful. We therefore introduce HERMES , a H arness E ngineering framework for software enginee R ing via M odular E xecutable Dev-Primitive S , which adds two mechanisms. Dynamic activation localizes the components likely to implement the reported behavior, follows their dependencies to the callers, configurations, and tests that may need to change with them, and instantiates only the Dev-Primitives in this candidate set, which modify their artifacts and exchange requirements before the repository is executed. Because a single round often leaves the issue unresolved, and execution reports only that the repository still fails rather than which component should be revised, a bug diagnosis mechanism traces the failure back to the components it implicates and reactivates only those primitives, repeating until the repository passes or a revision budget is exhausted.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，仅凭 Dev-Primitives 本身并不能确定一项任务应涉及哪些组件：仓库可能包含数千个组件，而激活所有组件将是一种浪费。 因此，我们引入了 HERMES——一个用于通过模块化可执行 Dev-Primitive S 进行软件工程的黑盒工程框架，它增加了两项机制。 动态激活机制能够定位可能实现所报告行为的组件，追踪这些组件对调用者、配置以及可能需要随之更改的测试的依赖关系，并且仅实例化该候选集中的 Dev-Primitives；这些 Dev-Primitives 会在仓库执行之前修改其产物并交换需求。 由于单次运行通常无法解决问题，且执行报告只会指出仓库仍然失败，而不会说明哪个组件需要修改，因此故障诊断机制会将故障追溯到相关组件，并仅重新激活这些基础单元，重复此过程直到仓库通过测试或修订预算用尽。

Under the default GPT-5.6 Sol setting with medium reasoning effort, it improves performance by 12.4 percentage points on average. With strong activation and diagnosis models, HERMES using Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives stays within 4.5 percentage points of the homogeneous GPT-5.6 Sol configuration while reducing inference cost by 26.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.0. sents.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
sents.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce Dev-Primitives , modular executable interfaces that turn repository components into active software engineering participants capable of localized reasoning, natural-language inter-component communication, and self-modification.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Dev-Primitives，这是一种模块化的可执行接口，能够将仓库组件转化为主动的软件工程参与者，使其具备局部推理、自然语言跨组件通信和自我修改的能力。

paragraphs.en: We propose HERMES , a H arness E ngineering framework for software enginee R ing via M odular E xecutable Dev-Primitive S , which instantiates Dev-Primitives at repository scale through a dependency-aware dynamic activation mechanism and a bug diagnosis mechanism that maps execution evidence back to the components that must be fixed.

paragraphs.en: Software Engineering Agents and Long-Horizon Evaluation. SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and CodeAct ( Wang et al., 2024 ) place an LLM in an executable environment where it can inspect repositories, edit code, run commands, and react to runtime feedback, while Agentless ( Xia et al., 2025 ) and AutoCodeRover ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) prescribe explicit localization and repair stages, and other systems distribute work across designer-specified roles or file-level developers under centralized coordination ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Tao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Evaluation has meanwhile moved toward sustained terminal interaction and multi-stage software workflows ( Merrill et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) , and toward repository-scale consistency during software evolution, repository generation, and whole-repository migration ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) , where context growth, semantic drift, and state preservation become bottlenecks for long-running agents ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: Key Differences. These systems differ from Dev-Primitives in the unit to which reasoning capability is attached. Prior agents assign work to designer-specified roles or centrally coordinated file-level tasks, so the reasoning units and the paths along which they exchange information are fixed in advance ( Tao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) ; prior primitives encapsulate reusable, task-agnostic behaviors ( Jin et al., 2026a ; Jin et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) ; and context-management methods keep information inside a single trajectory ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . A Dev-Primitive is instead defined by the artifact it owns, so the set of primitives is induced by the repository and requirements flow along its dependency edges, and HERMES activates these primitives on demand and revises them from execution evidence. Appendix A gives an extended discussion.

paragraphs.en: HERMES is built on Dev-Primitives , modular and executable interfaces that transform repository components into active participants in software engineering. Since only a small subset of components is relevant to a given issue, HERMES instantiates Dev-Primitives on demand through a dynamic activation mechanism that localizes likely components and expands along their dependencies. The activated primitives modify their own artifacts and are validated in an execution environment. Because execution reveals only that the repository still fails, HERMES additionally employs a bug diagnosis mechanism that maps the observed failure back to components implicated by the evidence, so that each revision round reactivates only those primitives. An overview of HERMES is shown in Fig. 1 .
paragraphs.zh: HERMES 构建于 Dev-Primitives 之上，这是一种模块化且可执行的接口，能够将仓库组件转化为软件工程中的活跃参与者。 由于仅有一小部分组件与特定问题相关，HERMES 通过动态激活机制按需实例化 Dev-Primitives：该机制会定位可能相关的组件，并沿着其依赖关系进行扩展。 被激活的原语会修改自身的产物，并在执行环境中进行验证。 由于执行过程仅表明仓库仍存在故障，HERMES 还采用了一种故障诊断机制，将观察到的故障映射回由证据所涉及的组件，从而确保每次迭代仅重新激活这些原语。 HERMES 的概述如图 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: A Dev-Primitive wraps an individual repository component, such as a source file, configuration file, or test file, with a resident LLM . Each primitive has direct access to the artifact it represents and is responsible for reasoning about and modifying that artifact during software engineering. Unlike conventional agents that repeatedly retrieve repository files as passive context, Dev-Primitives turn these components into active participants that can interpret natural-language requests, communicate implementation requirements with other components, and directly edit their own artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 一个 Dev-Primitive 将单个仓库组件（例如源文件、配置文件或测试文件）与一个驻留的 LLM 相结合。 每个 primitive 都能直接访问其所代表的工件，并负责在软件工程过程中对该工件进行推理和修改。 与传统的智能体不同，后者会反复获取仓库文件作为被动上下文，而 Dev-Primitives 则将这些组件转变为主动参与者，它们能够解释自然语言请求、与其他组件沟通实现要求，并直接编辑自身的工件。

paragraphs.en: Inter-primitive communication. The message m i m_{i} carries what the primitive discovered while reasoning over its own implementation and what it therefore requires of other components: interface changes, implementation requirements, dependency updates, configuration constraints, or testing requirements. Messages are directed rather than broadcast. A primitive sends only to the components its local reasoning implicates, which are in practice its callers, callees, configurations, and tests, so the communication topology follows the repository’s dependency structure rather than a predefined organization. Messages produced in a round enter the communication context 𝒞 j \mathcal{C}_{j} of their recipients before that round terminates, so a primitive may revise its own modification after receiving a requirement from another component. Participation does not imply modification: a primitive may contribute information about its implementation while leaving its own artifact unchanged.

Each receives its local objective x i x_{i} from the plan together with the messages 𝒞 i \mathcal{C}_{i} addressed to it by other activated primitives, reasons over its own artifact in light of both, and produces ( a i ′ , m i ) = P i ​ ( a i , x i , 𝒞 i ) (a_{i}^{\prime},m_{i})=P_{i}(a_{i},x_{i},\mathcal{C}_{i}) : an optionally modified artifact and an outgoing message carrying the requirements that its modification imposes elsewhere. paragraphs.en: Bug Diagnosis. A single round of modification often leaves the issue unresolved, and execution then reports only whether the repository still fails, not which component should be revised. Bug diagnosis supplies this attribution, returning v = DIAGNOSE ⁡ ( q , Π , ℛ ′ , o ) ∈ { pass , fail } v=\operatorname{DIAGNOSE}(q,\Pi,\mathcal{R}^{\prime},o)\in\{\textsc{pass},\textsc{fail}\} and, when v = fail v=\textsc{fail} , structured feedback ϕ = ( e , c , u ) \phi=(e,c,u) : the observed failure, the suspected root cause together with the components implicated by the evidence, and revision guidance. paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate HERMES on four benchmarks spanning complementary software engineering settings. SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) covers real-world GitHub issue resolution with human-validated tasks; SWE Refactor Bench ( Hong et al., 2026 ) targets whole-repository migration and coordinated cross-file modification; Terminal-Bench 4.0 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) measures performance on interactive terminal-based tasks; and DevOps-Gym ( Tang et al., 2026 ) spans build and configuration, monitoring, issue resolution, test generation, and end-to-end multi-stage workflows.

paragraphs.en: Baselines and Implementation Details. We follow the official leaderboard settings and evaluation protocols of each benchmark, and run HERMES with the backbones used by the published configurations under each baseline’s matched setting. Our evaluations use seven backbones: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Claude Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , DeepSeek-V4 ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Unless otherwise specified, we use medium reasoning effort where configurable and a revision budget of B = 3 B=3 . In every result table, each group compares a baseline harness with HERMES on the identical backbone and reasoning effort; only the harness differs, and Δ \Delta is the percentage-point gain over that row’s baseline; HERMES is run once per backbone, Qwen3-8B is evaluated with HERMES only, and blue and orange mark the best and second-best value per column. Backbone assignments, execution isolation, primitive runtime, ablation settings, and baseline provenance are given in Appendix E and Appendix F .

paragraphs.en: On SWE-bench Verified. paragraphs.en: Backbone Scaling. Table 6 shows that HERMES benefits from allocating larger models to dynamic activation and bug diagnosis while keeping the Dev-Primitives lightweight. Strengthening diagnosis consistently helps more than strengthening activation: on Terminal-Bench, using GPT-5.5 only for diagnosis improves resolution from 27.6% to 46.1% ( + 18.5 +18.5 ) against 36.7% ( + 9.1 +9.1 ) for activation alone, and the same ordering holds on SWE-bench Verified ( + 5.8 +5.8 versus + 3.8 +3.8 ). paragraphs.en: Component Contribution. Table 9 shows a consistent ordering of component importance. Replacing Dev-Primitives with a centralized editor over the same selected components is the most damaging, 14.2 points on SWE Refactor Bench and 13.0 on Terminal-Bench, and a compute-matched editor still trails HERMES by 6.3 points (Appendix G ). Among the remaining mechanisms, diagnosis feedback matters most, followed by execution feedback. This is a consequence of the abstraction rather than an argument against it: once edits are artifact-local, a failure observed at the repository level must be routed back to the component that owns the responsible implementation, and a monolithic agent has no such routing problem because it has no owners. Inter-primitive communication matters more on SWE Refactor Bench and Terminal-Bench, 7.5 and 5.7 points, than on SWE-bench Verified, 2.8 points, consistent with its role in coordinating changes that span files. Removing on-demand activation costs at most 3.0 points but raises inference cost by 1.61–1.88 × \times . The same ordering holds for the other two backbones (Appendix F.2 ).

paragraphs.en: We introduced Dev-Primitives , modular executable interfaces that turn repository components from passive artifacts into active participants in software engineering, and HERMES , a harness engineering framework that instantiates them through dynamic activation, localized collaboration, environment execution, and diagnosis-driven revision. Across four benchmarks, HERMES improves over matched baseline harnesses by 12.4 percentage points on average, and with strong activation and diagnosis models it stays within 4.5 points of the homogeneous GPT-5.6 Sol configuration while running Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives, at 26.2% lower inference cost on Terminal-Bench 4.0. These results highlight harness design as a key factor in translating model capability into effective software engineering behavior. Limitations are discussed in Appendix I .

paragraphs.en: Software Engineering Agent Architectures. Recent software engineering agents increasingly combine LLM reasoning with executable environments. Systems such as SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and CodeAct ( Wang et al., 2024 ) support repository inspection, code editing, command execution, and runtime feedback, while Agentless ( Xia et al., 2025 ) and AutoCodeRover ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) introduce more explicit localization and repair stages. Other systems distribute work across specialized roles or file-level developers under centralized coordination ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Tao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程智能体架构。 近期的软件工程智能体越来越多地将大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力与可执行环境相结合。 诸如 SWE-agent（Yang 等人，2024）、OpenHands（Wang 等人，2025）和 CodeAct（Wang 等人，2024）的系统支持仓库检查、代码编辑、命令执行和运行时反馈，而 Agentless（Xia 等人，2025）和 AutoCodeRover（Zhang 等人，2024）则引入了更明确的定位与修复阶段。 其他系统则在集中式协调下，将任务分配给专门的角色或文件级别的开发者（Chen 等人，2024；Liu 等人，2024；Tao 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Long-Horizon Software Engineering. Recent evaluation has increasingly moved beyond isolated issue resolution toward tasks that require sustained interaction with executable environments. Terminal-Bench ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) and DevOps-Gym ( Tang et al., 2026 ) evaluate sustained terminal interaction and multi-stage software workflows, while repository-scale benchmarks expose difficulties in maintaining consistency across components during software evolution, repository generation, and whole-repository migration ( Le et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) . Related work on context and repository memory further identifies context growth, semantic drift, and state preservation as bottlenecks in long-running software agents ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . These findings motivate architectures that can maintain task-relevant state near the repository components that generate and consume it, rather than repeatedly reconstructing this state inside a single growing reasoning trajectory.

paragraphs.en: Reusable and Modular Agent Capabilities. A related line of work studies how agent capabilities can be learned, distilled, reused, or composed across tasks. SWE-Gym ( Pan et al., 2024 ) , SWE-smith ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and Lingma SWE-GPT ( Ma et al., 2024 ) learn software engineering behavior from repository-level trajectories, while P2T ( Ma et al., 2026 ) emphasizes high-quality process supervision. Other work represents reusable capabilities explicitly through modular abstractions, including Agent Primitives ( Jin et al., 2026a ) , Tool Primitives ( Jin et al., 2026b ) , AgentDistill ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) , and CODESKILL ( Li et al., 2026 ) . These methods modularize reusable reasoning procedures, skills, or tool-use capabilities so that they can be invoked and composed by an agent. In particular, Tool Primitives expose tools through agent-native natural-language interfaces, hiding schema resolution and execution details from the calling model. Dev-Primitives adopt a related modular perspective, but attach the capability to mutable repository artifacts rather than reusable task-agnostic behaviors or external tools.
paragraphs.zh: 可复用且模块化的智能体能力。 相关研究探讨了智能体能力如何在不同任务中被学习、蒸馏、复用或组合。 SWE-Gym（Pan 等人，2024）、SWE-smith（Yang 等人，2026）和 Lingma SWE-GPT（Ma 等人，2024）从仓库级轨迹中学习软件工程行为，而 P2T（Ma 等人，2026）则强调高质量的过程监督。 其他研究通过模块化抽象明确表示可复用的能力，包括 Agent Primitives（Jin 等人，2026a）、Tool Primitives（Jin 等人，2026b）、AgentDistill（Qiu 等人，2025）和 CODESKILL（Li 等人，2026）。 这些方法将可复用的推理流程、技能或工具使用能力模块化，以便智能体可以调用和组合它们。 具体而言，Tool Primitives 通过原生于智能体的自然语言接口暴露工具，从而隐藏模式解析和执行细节，避免调用模型直接处理这些细节。 Dev-Primitives 采用了类似的模块化视角，但将能力附加到可修改的仓库工件上，而非可复用的任务无关行为或外部工具。

paragraphs.en: Key Differences. Dev-Primitives differ from prior software-engineering agents and reusable primitives in the unit to which reasoning capability is attached. First, prior systems decompose work across software-engineering roles or centrally assigned file-level tasks ( Tao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Even when individual developers are responsible for specific files, coordination is organized through a manager, shared plan, or design contract, so both the set of reasoning units and the paths along which they exchange information are fixed by the designer rather than by the repository. Dev-Primitives instead pair each repository component with a resident LLM that reasons over the component’s current implementation, functionality, and dependencies. A component can therefore discover requirements during modification and communicate them directly to the components that must satisfy them, without requiring a central agent to reconstruct and relay all component-specific state. Second, existing primitive- and skill-based methods encapsulate reusable, task-agnostic behaviors, reasoning procedures, or tools ( Jin et al., 2026a ; Jin et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026 ) , whereas a Dev-Primitive is bound to a specific mutable artifact and evolves together with that artifact throughout execution. Third, context-management approaches primarily compress, retrieve, or reorganize information within a centralized agent trajectory ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Dev-Primitives instead keep implementation state associated with the repository components that own it and exchange only task-relevant constraints when coordination is required. Building on this artifact-bound representation, HERMES dynamically activates task-relevant Dev-Primitives and coordinates their modification through environment execution, diagnosis feedback, and revision.
paragraphs.zh: 关键差异。 Dev-Primitives 与先前的软件工程智能体及可重用基础单元不同，其推理能力所依附的单元层级存在差异。 首先，先前系统将工作分解到不同的软件工程角色或中央分配的文件级任务中（Tao et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2026b）。 即使单个开发者负责特定文件，协调仍通过管理者、共享计划或设计合同来组织，因此推理单元集合及其信息交换路径均由设计者而非代码库决定。 相比之下，Dev-Primitives 将每个代码库组件与一个常驻的 LLM 配对，该 LLM 会针对组件当前的实现、功能和依赖关系进行推理。 因此，组件在修改过程中可以发现需求，并直接将其传达给必须满足这些需求的组件，而无需中央智能体重构和转达所有组件特定的状态信息。 其次，现有的基于基础单元和技能的方法封装了可重用、与任务无关的行为、推理流程或工具（Jin et al., 2026a；Jin et al., 2026b；Li et al., 2026），而 Dev-Primitive 则绑定于一个特定的可变工件，并在整个执行过程中与该工件共同演化。 第三，上下文管理方法主要是在中央智能体的轨迹中对信息进行压缩、检索或重组（Liu et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a）。 相比之下，Dev-Primitives 将实现状态保留在与之关联的代码库组件中，并在需要协调时仅交换与任务相关的约束条件。 基于这种绑定于工件的表示方式，HERMES 会动态激活与任务相关的 Dev-Primitives，并通过环境执行、诊断反馈和修订来协调它们的修改。

paragraphs.en: This section provides detailed specifications of the components used in HERMES, including how the dynamic activation and bug diagnosis mechanisms described in Section 3 are implemented with an LLM. HERMES consists of an activation module, a dynamically activated set of Dev-Primitives, an executable environment, and a diagnosis module. The activation module operates at the repository level to identify task-relevant components and assign localized objectives. Each Dev-Primitive reasons over and modifies the repository artifact it represents, while communicating task-relevant information to other activated primitives. The resulting repository is evaluated in an executable environment, and the diagnosis module converts execution evidence into structured feedback for targeted revision.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes the full HERMES pipeline. Starting from software issue q q , the activation module identifies task-relevant repository components and assigns localized objectives to their Dev-Primitives. The activated primitives collaborate through natural-language communication and modify their local artifacts. HERMES then executes the resulting repository, and the diagnosis module analyzes the execution evidence. Failed execution produces structured feedback for targeted revision. This loop continues until the task passes evaluation or the maximum revision budget is exhausted. Here, B B denotes the maximum number of revision rounds after the initial execution.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 总结了完整的 HERMES 流程。 从软件问题 q q 开始，激活模块会识别与任务相关的仓库组件，并为它们的 Dev-Primitives 分配局部目标。 被激活的 primitives 通过自然语言通信进行协作，并修改其本地产物。 随后，HERMES 会执行生成的仓库，诊断模块则分析执行证据。 执行失败会产生结构化反馈，用于有针对性的修订。 该循环将持续运行，直到任务通过评估或最大修订预算用尽为止。 此处，B B 表示初始执行之后允许的最大修订轮数。

paragraphs.en: LLM Instantiation of Each Mechanism. Both mechanisms described in Section 3 are implemented by prompting an LLM. Dynamic activation is realized by a single LLM call chain that inspects the repository structure, retrieves candidate files, and returns the selected component set 𝒜 \mathcal{A} together with a local objective x i x_{i} for each selected component; it is not a static retriever, since the dependency expansion is carried out by the model reading the candidate files rather than by a precomputed call graph. Bug diagnosis is likewise realized by a single LLM call that receives the issue, the current plan, the modified repository state, and the execution observation, and returns the verdict v v together with structured feedback ϕ = ( e , c , u ) \phi=(e,c,u) . Each Dev-Primitive is instantiated with its own LLM, which may differ from the models used by the two mechanisms; the heterogeneous configurations in Section 4.3 exploit this separation. Neither mechanism can override deterministic execution outcomes: a trajectory with failing task-visible tests, unsuccessful compilation, or other observed execution failures cannot be accepted on the basis of model judgment alone. The prompts used for both mechanisms are listed in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 每种机制的 LLM 实例化。 第 3 节中描述的两种机制均通过提示 LLM 来实现。 动态激活由单个 LLM 调用链实现：该调用链会检查仓库结构、获取候选文件，并返回选定的组件集合 𝒜 \mathcal{A} 以及每个选定组件的局部目标 x i x_{i}；它并非静态检索器，因为依赖项的扩展是由模型读取候选文件完成的，而非通过预计算的调用图。 错误诊断同样由单个 LLM 调用实现：该调用接收问题描述、当前计划、修改后的仓库状态和执行观察结果，并返回判定结果 v v 以及结构化反馈 ϕ = ( e , c , u ) \phi=(e,c,u) 。 每个开发原语都使用其专属的 LLM 进行实例化，这些模型可能与两种机制所用模型不同；第 4.3 节中的异构配置正是利用了这种分离。 这两种机制都无法覆盖确定性执行结果：如果任务可见的测试失败、编译未成功或观察到其他执行失败，仅凭模型判断便无法接受该执行轨迹。 用于两种机制的提示词列于附录 C 中。

paragraphs.en: Execution and Evaluation Isolation. HERMES separates the execution environment available during task solving from the benchmark evaluator used to compute the final score. During a trajectory, dynamic activation, the Dev-Primitives, and bug diagnosis may use only information available from the task repository and its execution environment, including repository-provided tests, build commands, linters, type checkers, runtime outputs, stack traces, logs, and reproduction scripts constructed during solving. Benchmark-held-out evaluation tests and final grading outcomes are not exposed to HERMES during task execution.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether dynamic activation selects the repository components required for each task. For benchmarks with reference patches, we use the files modified by the developer patch as the target component set and compare them with the Dev-Primitives selected by HERMES. For benchmarks without a unique reference patch, we construct the target set from benchmark-specific supervision: for SWE Refactor Bench, we use the repository components implicated by the task specification and grading artifacts; for Terminal-Bench, we use the files and artifacts accessed or modified by the oracle solution; and for DevOps-Gym, we use the reference artifacts associated with build, issue-resolving, and test-generation tasks, excluding monitoring tasks from file-level selection evaluation. Let 𝒢 ⊆ { 1 , … , N } \mathcal{G}\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\} denote the indices of the target components and 𝒜 \mathcal{A} the indices of Dev-Primitives activated across all planning and revision rounds. We report selection recall, | 𝒜 ∩ 𝒢 | / | 𝒢 | |\mathcal{A}\cap\mathcal{G}|/|\mathcal{G}| , selection precision, | 𝒜 ∩ 𝒢 | / | 𝒜 | |\mathcal{A}\cap\mathcal{G}|/|\mathcal{A}| , and the average number of activated Dev-Primitives per task. We additionally separate solved and failed tasks to examine how selection quality relates to downstream task completion. Recall and precision, including the solved and failed breakdowns, are micro-averaged over components within each benchmark. For SWE Refactor Bench, we regard a task as solved when it receives a non-zero composite score, indicating that it passes the migration audit and behavioral checks and reaches the verifier stage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估动态激活机制是否能为每个任务选择所需的仓库组件。 对于具有参考补丁的基准测试，我们将开发者补丁中修改的文件作为目标组件集，并与 HERMES 选择的 Dev-Primitives 进行比较。 对于没有唯一参考补丁的基准测试，我们从基准测试特定的监督信息中构建目标集：对于 SWE Refactor Bench，我们使用任务说明和评分产物所涉及的仓库组件；对于 Terminal-Bench，我们使用 oracle 解决方案访问或修改的文件和产物；而对于 DevOps-Gym，我们使用与构建、问题解决和测试生成任务相关的参考产物，但在文件级选择评估中排除监控任务。 令 𝒢 ⊆ { 1 , … , N } \mathcal{G}\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\} 表示目标组件的索引，𝒜 \mathcal{A} 表示在所有规划和修订轮次中被激活的 Dev-Primitives 的索引。 我们报告选择召回率 | 𝒜 ∩ 𝒢 | / | 𝒢 | |\mathcal{A}\cap\mathcal{G}|/|\mathcal{G}|、选择精确率 | 𝒜 ∩ 𝒢 | / | 𝒜 | |\mathcal{A}\cap\mathcal{G}|/|\mathcal{A}|，以及每个任务平均激活的 Dev-Primitives 数量。 我们进一步将已解决的任务和失败的任务分开，以考察选择质量与下游任务完成之间的关系。 召回率和精确率（包括已解决和失败的细分）在每个基准测试内的组件上采用微平均计算。 对于 SWE Refactor Bench，当任务获得非零的复合分数时，我们将其视为已解决，这表明该任务通过了迁移审计和行为检查，并进入了验证器阶段。

sents.zh: 当一个原始智能体再次被激活时，它会接收到当前的工件、分配给它的目标，以及与该组件相关的通信上下文。

paragraphs.en: Inter-Primitive Communication. Dev-Primitives communicate through explicit natural-language messages. A primitive can communicate implementation requirements, interface changes, dependency information, expected behavior, or other constraints to another active primitive. Each message is addressed by the sending primitive to a specific target and placed verbatim into the target’s communication context 𝒞 j \mathcal{C}_{j} . No central agent interprets, filters, or rewrites messages, and they are not merged into a single global reasoning trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 原始体间通信。 开发者与原始体通过明确的自然语言消息进行通信。 一个原始体可以将实现要求、接口变更、依赖信息、预期行为或其他约束条件传达给另一个活跃的原始体。 每条消息都由发送的原始体指定特定的目标，并逐字放入目标的通信上下文 𝒞 j \mathcal{C}_{j} 中。 没有中央智能体对消息进行解释、过滤或改写，且这些消息也不会被合并为单一的全局推理轨迹。

sents.en: Inter-Primitive Communication.
sents.zh: 原始体间通信。

sents.en: Dev-Primitives communicate through explicit natural-language messages.
sents.zh: 开发者与原始体通过明确的自然语言消息进行通信。

sents.en: A primitive can communicate implementation requirements, interface changes, dependency information, expected behavior, or other constraints to another active primitive.
sents.zh: 一个原始体可以将实现要求、接口变更、依赖信息、预期行为或其他约束条件传达给另一个活跃的原始体。

sents.en: Each message is addressed by the sending primitive to a specific target and placed verbatim into the target’s communication context 𝒞 j \mathcal{C}_{j} .
sents.zh: 每条消息都由发送的原始体指定特定的目标，并逐字放入目标的通信上下文 𝒞 j \mathcal{C}_{j} 中。

paragraphs.en: Communication is interleaved with local modification rather than performed as a fixed all-to-all stage. A primitive sends a message when its local task depends on another component or when its modification introduces a requirement that another component must satisfy. This allows communication to follow repository dependencies encountered during execution rather than requiring every activated primitive to communicate with every other primitive.
paragraphs.zh: 通信与局部修改交替进行，而不是作为固定的全连接阶段执行。 当一个原始单元的地方任务依赖于另一个组件，或者当它的修改引入了另一个组件必须满足的需求时，它会发送消息。 这使得通信能够遵循执行过程中遇到的存储库依赖关系，而无需每个被激活的原始单元都与其他所有原始单元进行通信。

sents.en: Communication is interleaved with local modification rather than performed as a fixed all-to-all stage.
sents.zh: 通信与局部修改交替进行，而不是作为固定的全连接阶段执行。

sents.en: A primitive sends a message when its local task depends on another component or when its modification introduces a requirement that another component must satisfy.
sents.zh: 当一个原始单元的地方任务依赖于另一个组件，或者当它的修改引入了另一个组件必须满足的需求时，它会发送消息。

paragraphs.en: On-Demand Activation. The activation module activates only the Dev-Primitives selected as relevant to the current plan. Inactive components remain available in the repository but do not receive model calls or participate in communication during that round. The active set may change across revision rounds: execution and diagnosis feedback may cause the activation module to activate additional components, remove previously activated components, or revise their assigned objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 按需激活。 激活模块仅激活当前计划中被选为相关的开发基础组件。 非活动组件在知识库中仍然可用，但在该轮次中不会接收模型调用或参与通信。 活动组件集可能在不同修订轮次中发生变化：执行和诊断反馈可能导致激活模块激活更多组件、移除先前已激活的组件，或调整其分配的目标。

sents.en: On-Demand Activation.
sents.zh: 按需激活。

sents.en: The activation module activates only the Dev-Primitives selected as relevant to the current plan.
sents.zh: 激活模块仅激活当前计划中被选为相关的开发基础组件。

paragraphs.en: Creation of New Components. When solving a task requires a new persistent source, test, configuration, build, or other repository file, an active Dev-Primitive may create the artifact. HERMES subsequently registers the new artifact as a Dev-Primitive so that it can participate in later communication and revision rounds. Temporary outputs, caches, logs, and other transient execution artifacts are treated as environment observations rather than Dev-Primitives.
paragraphs.zh: 创建新组件。 当解决任务需要新的持久化源、测试文件、配置文件、构建文件或其他仓库文件时，一个活跃的 Dev-Primitive 可以创建该工件。 HERMES 随后会将这个新工件注册为 Dev-Primitive，以便其能够参与后续的通信和修订环节。 临时输出、缓存、日志和其他瞬态执行工件被视为环境观察，而非 Dev-Primitive。

sents.en: Creation of New Components.
sents.zh: 创建新组件。

sents.en: When solving a task requires a new persistent source, test, configuration, build, or other repository file, an active Dev-Primitive may create the artifact.
sents.zh: 当解决任务需要新的持久化源、测试文件、配置文件、构建文件或其他仓库文件时，一个活跃的 Dev-Primitive 可以创建该工件。

sents.en: HERMES subsequently registers the new artifact as a Dev-Primitive so that it can participate in later communication and revision rounds.
sents.zh: HERMES 随后会将这个新工件注册为 Dev-Primitive，以便其能够参与后续的通信和修订环节。

sents.en: Temporary outputs, caches, logs, and other transient execution artifacts are treated as environment observations rather than Dev-Primitives.
sents.zh: 临时输出、缓存、日志和其他瞬态执行工件被视为环境观察，而非 Dev-Primitive。

paragraphs.en: Component Granularity. For repository-level software engineering tasks, we use files as the default Dev-Primitive granularity. A component may therefore correspond to a source file, test file, configuration file, build specification, script, or another persistent repository artifact. This provides a stable mapping between executable repository artifacts and Dev-Primitives without introducing the overhead of assigning separate agents to individual functions or symbols.
paragraphs.zh: 组件粒度。 对于仓库级别的软件工程任务，我们将文件用作默认的 Dev-Primitive 粒度。 因此，一个组件可能对应于源代码文件、测试文件、配置文件、构建规范、脚本或仓库中的其他持久化产物。 这为可执行的仓库产物与 Dev-Primitives 之间提供了稳定的映射，而无需为单个函数或符号分配独立的智能体所带来的额外负担。

sents.en: Component Granularity.
sents.zh: 组件粒度。

sents.en: For repository-level software engineering tasks, we use files as the default Dev-Primitive granularity.
sents.zh: 对于仓库级别的软件工程任务，我们将文件用作默认的 Dev-Primitive 粒度。

sents.en: A component may therefore correspond to a source file, test file, configuration file, build specification, script, or another persistent repository artifact.
sents.zh: 因此，一个组件可能对应于源代码文件、测试文件、配置文件、构建规范、脚本或仓库中的其他持久化产物。

sents.en: This provides a stable mapping between executable repository artifacts and Dev-Primitives without introducing the overhead of assigning separate agents to individual functions or symbols.
sents.zh: 这为可执行的仓库产物与 Dev-Primitives 之间提供了稳定的映射，而无需为单个函数或符号分配独立的智能体所带来的额外负担。

paragraphs.en: Terminal-Bench tasks do not always follow the structure of a conventional software repository. We therefore treat persistent filesystem artifacts that can be independently inspected or modified as components, including source files, shell scripts, configuration files, service definitions, build files, and other task-relevant artifacts. Runtime processes, terminal outputs, and transient system state are treated as environment observations rather than Dev-Primitives.
paragraphs.zh: Terminal-Bench 任务并不总是遵循传统软件仓库的结构。 因此，我们将那些可以独立检查或修改的持久化文件系统产物视为组件，包括源文件、外壳脚本、配置文件、服务定义、构建文件以及其他与任务相关的产物。 运行时进程、终端输出和临时系统状态被视为环境观察，而非开发原语。

sents.en: Terminal-Bench tasks do not always follow the structure of a conventional software repository.
sents.zh: Terminal-Bench 任务并不总是遵循传统软件仓库的结构。

sents.en: We therefore treat persistent filesystem artifacts that can be independently inspected or modified as components, including source files, shell scripts, configuration files, service definitions, build files, and other task-relevant artifacts.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将那些可以独立检查或修改的持久化文件系统产物视为组件，包括源文件、外壳脚本、配置文件、服务定义、构建文件以及其他与任务相关的产物。

sents.en: Runtime processes, terminal outputs, and transient system state are treated as environment observations rather than Dev-Primitives.
sents.zh: 运行时进程、终端输出和临时系统状态被视为环境观察，而非开发原语。

paragraphs.en: For the component ablation study, we use the complete HERMES configuration as the reference and disable one mechanism at a time while keeping the backbone model, reasoning effort, revision budget, and benchmark environment unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 在组件消融研究中，我们以完整的 HERMES 配置作为参考，每次仅禁用一种机制，同时保持骨干模型、推理努力程度、修订预算和基准环境不变。

paragraphs.en: w/o Inter-Primitive Communication. Dev-Primitives retain their local reasoning and editing capabilities but cannot exchange messages with one another. Each primitive receives its objective from the activation module and independently modifies its own component. Information across repository components can therefore only be recovered indirectly through subsequent planning and execution.
paragraphs.zh: 无原始体间通信。 Dev-Primitives 保留其本地推理和编辑能力，但无法相互交换消息。 每个原始体从激活模块接收其目标，并独立修改自身的组件。 因此，不同存储库组件之间的信息只能通过后续的规划和执行间接恢复。

sents.en: w/o Inter-Primitive Communication.
sents.zh: 无原始体间通信。

sents.en: Dev-Primitives retain their local reasoning and editing capabilities but cannot exchange messages with one another.
sents.zh: Dev-Primitives 保留其本地推理和编辑能力，但无法相互交换消息。

sents.en: Each primitive receives its objective from the activation module and independently modifies its own component.
sents.zh: 每个原始体从激活模块接收其目标，并独立修改自身的组件。

sents.en: Information across repository components can therefore only be recovered indirectly through subsequent planning and execution.
sents.zh: 因此，不同存储库组件之间的信息只能通过后续的规划和执行间接恢复。

paragraphs.en: w/o On-Demand Activation. We retain the same initial task analysis and component identification procedure, but remove on-demand invocation of Dev-Primitives. In the complete HERMES configuration, the activation module activates a primitive only when its associated component is required by the current plan, and the active set may change after execution feedback and revision. In this ablation, all Dev-Primitives identified during the initial task analysis are activated at the beginning of the trajectory and remain active throughout subsequent planning and revision rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 无按需激活。 我们保留相同的初始任务分析和组件识别流程，但移除了对开发原语的按需调用。 在完整的 HERMES 配置中，激活模块仅在当前计划需要其关联组件时才会激活一个原语，并且在执行反馈与修订之后，活跃集合可能会发生变化。 在此消融实验中，初始任务分析期间识别出的所有开发原语都会在轨迹开始时被激活，并在后续的规划与修订轮次中保持活跃状态。

sents.en: w/o On-Demand Activation.
sents.zh: 无按需激活。

sents.en: We retain the same initial task analysis and component identification procedure, but remove on-demand invocation of Dev-Primitives.
sents.zh: 我们保留相同的初始任务分析和组件识别流程，但移除了对开发原语的按需调用。

sents.en: In the complete HERMES configuration, the activation module activates a primitive only when its associated component is required by the current plan, and the active set may change after execution feedback and revision.
sents.zh: 在完整的 HERMES 配置中，激活模块仅在当前计划需要其关联组件时才会激活一个原语，并且在执行反馈与修订之后，活跃集合可能会发生变化。

sents.en: In this ablation, all Dev-Primitives identified during the initial task analysis are activated at the beginning of the trajectory and remain active throughout subsequent planning and revision rounds.
sents.zh: 在此消融实验中，初始任务分析期间识别出的所有开发原语都会在轨迹开始时被激活，并在后续的规划与修订轮次中保持活跃状态。

paragraphs.en: w/o Execution Feedback. HERMES retains activation, the Dev-Primitives, inter-primitive communication, and diagnosis, but execution observations generated after repository modifications are not provided for subsequent revision. The diagnosis module therefore evaluates the modified repository against the task and current plan through static inspection alone, and cannot use test failures, runtime errors, command outputs, or execution traces to guide later rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 无执行反馈。 HERMES 保留了激活机制、开发原语、原语间通信和诊断功能，但仓库修改后生成的执行观察结果不会提供给后续修订环节。 因此，诊断模块仅通过静态检查来评估修改后的仓库与任务及当前计划的匹配程度，无法利用测试失败、运行时错误、命令输出或执行轨迹来指导后续迭代。

sents.en: w/o Execution Feedback.
sents.zh: 无执行反馈。

sents.en: HERMES retains activation, the Dev-Primitives, inter-primitive communication, and diagnosis, but execution observations generated after repository modifications are not provided for subsequent revision.
sents.zh: HERMES 保留了激活机制、开发原语、原语间通信和诊断功能，但仓库修改后生成的执行观察结果不会提供给后续修订环节。

sents.en: The diagnosis module therefore evaluates the modified repository against the task and current plan through static inspection alone, and cannot use test failures, runtime errors, command outputs, or execution traces to guide later rounds.
sents.zh: 因此，诊断模块仅通过静态检查来评估修改后的仓库与任务及当前计划的匹配程度，无法利用测试失败、运行时错误、命令输出或执行轨迹来指导后续迭代。

paragraphs.en: w/o Diagnosis Feedback. Environment execution remains enabled and its raw outputs remain available for subsequent planning, but the dedicated diagnosis module does not analyze the execution results or produce structured failure diagnosis and revision guidance. Revision therefore relies on the activation module’s direct interpretation of the available execution evidence. This setting differs from B = 0 B=0 : removing diagnosis feedback still permits subsequent planning and execution rounds, whereas B = 0 B=0 disables revision after the initial round.
paragraphs.zh: 无诊断反馈。 环境执行仍然启用，其原始输出也仍可用于后续规划，但专门的诊断模块不会分析执行结果，也不会生成结构化的故障诊断及修正指导。 因此，修正过程依赖于激活模块对可用执行证据的直接解读。 此设置与 B = 0 B=0 不同：移除诊断反馈后，后续规划和执行轮次仍然可以继续进行；而 B = 0 B=0 则会在初始轮次结束后禁用修正功能。

sents.en: w/o Diagnosis Feedback.
sents.zh: 无诊断反馈。

sents.en: Environment execution remains enabled and its raw outputs remain available for subsequent planning, but the dedicated diagnosis module does not analyze the execution results or produce structured failure diagnosis and revision guidance.
sents.zh: 环境执行仍然启用，其原始输出也仍可用于后续规划，但专门的诊断模块不会分析执行结果，也不会生成结构化的故障诊断及修正指导。

sents.en: Revision therefore relies on the activation module’s direct interpretation of the available execution evidence.
sents.zh: 因此，修正过程依赖于激活模块对可用执行证据的直接解读。

sents.en: This setting differs from B = 0 B=0 : removing diagnosis feedback still permits subsequent planning and execution rounds, whereas B = 0 B=0 disables revision after the initial round.
sents.zh: 此设置与 B = 0 B=0 不同：移除诊断反馈后，后续规划和执行轮次仍然可以继续进行；而 B = 0 B=0 则会在初始轮次结束后禁用修正功能。

paragraphs.en: Revision Budget. For the revision study, we vary B B while keeping all other components unchanged. B = 0 B=0 performs only the initial planning, modification, and execution cycle, whereas B > 0 B>0 permits up to B B additional revisions based on execution and diagnosis feedback. We use B = 3 B=3 as the default setting in the main experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 修订预算。 在修订研究中，我们改变 B 的值，同时保持所有其他组件不变。 当 B = 0 时，系统仅执行初始规划、修改和执行循环；而当 B > 0 时，系统允许根据执行和诊断反馈进行最多 B 次额外修订。 在主要实验中，我们将 B = 3 设为默认设置。

sents.en: Revision Budget.
sents.zh: 修订预算。

sents.en: For the revision study, we vary B B while keeping all other components unchanged.
sents.zh: 在修订研究中，我们改变 B 的值，同时保持所有其他组件不变。

sents.en: B = 0 B=0 performs only the initial planning, modification, and execution cycle, whereas B > 0 B>0 permits up to B B additional revisions based on execution and diagnosis feedback.
sents.zh: 当 B = 0 时，系统仅执行初始规划、修改和执行循环；而当 B > 0 时，系统允许根据执行和诊断反馈进行最多 B 次额外修订。

sents.en: We use B = 3 B=3 as the default setting in the main experiments.
sents.zh: 在主要实验中，我们将 B = 3 设为默认设置。

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench Verified. We evaluate HERMES on the 500 human-validated tasks in SWE-bench Verified using the official repository snapshots and evaluation procedure. During task solving, HERMES operates on the issue description, repository contents, and task-visible execution environment. Repository-provided tests and reproduction scripts constructed during solving may be executed, whereas benchmark evaluation tests are reserved for final scoring. We report the percentage of successfully resolved tasks.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 验证版。 我们使用官方仓库快照和评估流程，在 SWE-bench 验证版中由人类验证的 500 项任务上对 HERMES 进行评估。 在任务解决过程中，HERMES 会基于问题描述、仓库内容以及任务可见的执行环境进行操作。 仓库提供的测试以及在解决过程中构建的重现脚本可能会被执行，而基准评估测试则保留用于最终评分。 我们报告成功解决的任务的百分比。

sents.en: SWE-bench Verified.
sents.zh: SWE-bench 验证版。

sents.en: We evaluate HERMES on the 500 human-validated tasks in SWE-bench Verified using the official repository snapshots and evaluation procedure.
sents.zh: 我们使用官方仓库快照和评估流程，在 SWE-bench 验证版中由人类验证的 500 项任务上对 HERMES 进行评估。

sents.en: During task solving, HERMES operates on the issue description, repository contents, and task-visible execution environment.
sents.zh: 在任务解决过程中，HERMES 会基于问题描述、仓库内容以及任务可见的执行环境进行操作。

sents.zh: 我们报告成功解决的任务的百分比。

paragraphs.en: SWE Refactor Bench. We evaluate all 20 whole-repository migration tasks and report the benchmark composite score. HERMES operates on the provided repository, migration specification, and task-visible execution environment, while the benchmark grader is used only for final evaluation. For analyses that divide tasks into solved and failed groups, we regard a task as solved when it obtains a non-zero composite score, indicating that the migration passes the required audit and behavioral checks and reaches the verifier stage.
paragraphs.zh: SWE 重构基准测试。 我们评估了全部 20 个完整仓库迁移任务，并报告了基准测试的综合得分。 HERMES 在所提供的仓库、迁移规范以及任务可见的执行环境中运行，而基准测试评分器仅用于最终评估。 对于将任务分为“已解决”和“失败”组的分析，当任务获得非零的综合得分时，我们将其视为已解决，这表明该迁移通过了必要的审核和行为检查，并进入了验证阶段。

sents.en: SWE Refactor Bench.
sents.zh: SWE 重构基准测试。

sents.en: We evaluate all 20 whole-repository migration tasks and report the benchmark composite score.
sents.zh: 我们评估了全部 20 个完整仓库迁移任务，并报告了基准测试的综合得分。

sents.en: HERMES operates on the provided repository, migration specification, and task-visible execution environment, while the benchmark grader is used only for final evaluation.
sents.zh: HERMES 在所提供的仓库、迁移规范以及任务可见的执行环境中运行，而基准测试评分器仅用于最终评估。

paragraphs.en: Dev-Primitives vs. a Centralized Editor. We construct a controlled variant, denoted w/o Dev-Primitives (single editor) , that removes the Dev-Primitive abstraction while leaving the remaining HERMES pipeline unchanged. We use the same activation module, execution environment, diagnosis module, revision budget B = 3 B=3 , GPT-5.6 Sol backbone with medium reasoning effort, and, critically, the same component set 𝒜 \mathcal{A} selected by the activation module. Instead of assigning each selected component to its corresponding Dev-Primitive, a single Editor receives the complete plan Π = { ( i , x i ) } i ∈ 𝒜 \Pi=\{(i,x_{i})\}_{i\in\mathcal{A}} together with the contents of all selected components and modifies them jointly. This control preserves component localization while removing component-local reasoning and direct communication between components. It therefore tests whether Dev-Primitives provide benefits beyond exposing the same selected components to a centralized editing agent.
paragraphs.zh: 开发原语 vs. 集中式编辑器。 我们构建了一个受控变体，记作“无开发原语（单编辑器）”，该变体移除了开发原语抽象层，但保留了其余 HERMES 流程不变。 我们使用了相同的激活模块、执行环境、诊断模块、修订预算 B = 3 B=3、GPT-5.6 Sol 主干模型（中等推理强度），以及最关键的是，激活模块选择的相同组件集合 𝒜 \mathcal{A}。 与将每个选中的组件分配给其对应的开发原语不同，这里由单个编辑器接收完整的计划 Π = { ( i , x i ) } i ∈ 𝒜 \Pi=\{(i,x_{i})\}_{i\in\mathcal{A}}，以及所有选中组件的内容，并对它们进行联合修改。 这种控制方式保留了组件的局部化特性，同时移除了组件内部的局部推理以及组件之间的直接通信。 因此，该实验旨在检验开发原语是否提供了超越“将相同的选中组件暴露给一个集中式编辑智能体”之外的额外优势。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 13 , replacing Dev-Primitives with a centralized Editor reduces performance on all four benchmarks. The reduction is smaller on SWE-bench Verified, from 97.0% to 93.4%, but becomes substantially larger on benchmarks requiring coordination across multiple components: from 31.0% to 16.8% on SWE Refactor Bench, from 51.8% to 38.8% on Terminal-Bench, and from 55.41% to 44.21% on DevOps-Gym. Because both configurations operate on the same activation-selected component set, the difference cannot be attributed to component localization. Instead, the results are consistent with the benefit of component-local reasoning and direct propagation of cross-component requirements. The centralized Editor makes fewer model calls because it processes all selected components jointly, using 10–14% fewer tokens and 11–16% lower cost than HERMES, but this reduction is accompanied by considerably lower task performance.

paragraphs.en: Efficiency of On-Demand Activation. HERMES first identifies task-relevant components during planning, but does not require every identified Dev-Primitive to remain active throughout the trajectory. Instead, primitives are invoked when their components are needed by the current plan, and the active set may change after execution feedback and revision. In the w/o On-Demand Activation variant, the same initial task analysis and component identification are retained, but all Dev-Primitives identified during the initial analysis are activated at the beginning of the trajectory and remain active throughout subsequent planning and revision rounds. This ablation therefore does not activate every file in the repository; it removes the ability to selectively invoke and deactivate identified Dev-Primitives as the task evolves.

paragraphs.en: This case also illustrates a limitation of the reference-overlap selection metrics in Section 4.4 . Because those metrics use the developer-patch file set as ground truth, an alternative but behaviorally valid repair path can receive low reference overlap. Selection recall and precision should therefore be interpreted as agreement with the developer repair path rather than as exhaustive measures of all components capable of supporting a correct repair.
paragraphs.zh: 这个案例也说明了第 4.4 节中参考重叠选择指标的一个局限性。 由于这些指标以开发者补丁文件集为基准，因此一个替代但行为上有效的修复路径可能会获得较低的参考重叠度。 因此，选择召回率和精确度应被解释为与开发者修复路径的一致性，而非所有能够支持正确修复的组件的全面衡量标准。

paragraphs.en: HERMES introduces additional inference cost and latency because it invokes multiple Dev-Primitives, executes the repository, and performs iterative diagnosis. Its gains are also smaller in already saturated settings, such as SWE-bench Verified with the strongest backbones. In addition, performance depends on correctly activating task-relevant components and on informative execution feedback for revision; missed dependencies or sparse runtime signals can therefore limit recovery. We use files as the default Dev-Primitive granularity and evaluate on four software engineering benchmarks, leaving finer-grained primitives and broader software engineering settings for future work. Finally, Qwen3-8B is served locally with Ollama on NVIDIA A40 GPUs using the model’s default sampling parameters (temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 20) and Ollama’s 32K context window, while all other models are accessed through their official APIs; results may therefore vary with deployment settings and model updates.
paragraphs.zh: HERMES 会引入额外的推理成本和延迟，因为它需要调用多个 Dev-Primitive、执行代码库并进行迭代诊断。 在已经饱和的设置中（例如使用最强骨干模型的 SWE-bench Verified），其收益也较小。 此外，性能还取决于能否正确激活与任务相关的组件，以及能否获得有助于修订的丰富执行反馈；因此，遗漏的依赖关系或稀疏的运行时信号可能会限制恢复效果。 我们将文件作为默认的 Dev-Primitive 粒度，并在四个软件工程基准上进行评估，而更细粒度的 Primitive 和更广泛的软件工程设置则留待未来研究。 最后，Qwen3-8B 通过 Ollama 在 NVIDIA A40 GPU 上本地运行，并使用模型默认的采样参数（温度 0.6、top-p 0.95、top-k 20）以及 Ollama 的 32K 上下文窗口；而其他所有模型均通过其官方 API 访问，因此结果可能会因部署设置和模型更新而有所不同。
